basic_profile.bio: A 36-year-old aviation enthusiast from Bismarck, North Dakota, who has been a Redditor for nearly a decade. By day, I work as a commercial airline pilot, and by night, I immerse myself in my hobbies, which include martial arts, retro gaming, and debating fictional battles. Although flying keeps me busy, I always find time to engage with the Reddit community, especially when I'm on layovers. Single and enjoying it, I value my independence and the freedom to explore my passions without constraints. I'm usually online during evenings and weekends, often contributing to discussions that pique my interest.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Aviation Management and over a decade of flying experience, I possess an extensive understanding of aerodynamics and aviation safety. My expertise extends to martial arts, having trained in karate since childhood. Additionally, my love for sci-fi and fantasy has driven me to self-educate on various fictional universes, allowing me to participate knowledgeably in pop-culture debates.
